decisions.reason: The mitred handle family is a multi-model line backed by in-house tooling and finishing and is still listed in 2024, so its sunk investment and fit with the coordinated product-family strategy favor keeping it despite modest visibility.
The multifunctional handle was moved up to its own page in 2024, a growing public commitment that matches the firm's barrier-free and hygiene direction and makes dropping it unlikely.
This multi-model handle line is still on the website and represents tooling and range investment, so management is likely to keep it and treat its low profile as a temporary issue.
The award-winning collection has its own page and German Design and iF awards, giving it high visibility and strong justification for continued commitment.
